 The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) has accepted a court enforceable undertaking from Sea Swift Pty Ltd (Sea Swift) after Sea Swift acknowledged the ACCC’s concerns that Sea Swift’s conduct may constitute a misuse of market power and prohibited exclusive dealing under sections 46 and 47 of the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (CCA).
 
 The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) has accepted a court enforceable undertaking from Hismile Pty Ltd (Hismile) in relation to alleged false or misleading representations on Hismile’s social media accounts, that contravened or were likely to contravene sections 18, 29(1)(f), 29(1)(g) and 33 of the Australian Consumer Law.
 
 Ampol Limited
On 3 June 2026, the ACCC announced its decision to approve Ampol Retail Holding Pty Ltd’s acquisition of EG Group Australia and EG AsiaPac Holdings subject to conditions.
 
 On 2 June 2026, the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) amended an exemption granted on 24 February 2026 under section 56GD of the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) to Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Limited (ANZ) suspending its consumer data sharing obligations in respect of Suncorp Bank brand products from 3 October 2026 to 5 October 2026 (inclusive), to instead apply from 6 March 2027 to 8 March 2027 (inclusive). The ACCC amended the exemption in response to an application from ANZ.
 
 On 26 May 2026, the ACCC accepted a joint functional separation undertaking given by Superloop Limited on behalf of its wholesale and retail subsidiaries.
The undertaking came into force on 29 May 2026. 
 
 On 19 May 2026, the ACCC granted an exemption under section 56GD of the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) to Scottish Pacific Business Finance Pty Ltd deferring its product data sharing obligations until 13 July 2029, and its consumer data sharing obligations until 10 May 2030 in respect of its invoice finance products.
